notes: Deploy only IMDRocks (ERC-721 name IMDRocks, symbol IMDROCK) with zero ETH. Its sole constructor argument is the specified immutable reserve and payout address, which receives rocks 0 through 9. Supply is capped at 100; nextRock starts at 10. Each buy mints the next rock and requires exactly 10000000000000 * (1 + n * n) wei. State is updated before callbacks; purchases are guarded against reentrancy, forward the entire payment, and revert if payout fails. Art and metadata are fully on-chain, with one shared SVG drawing and 100 distinct tints. No launch token, pool, initialization calls, owner, admin, pause, upgrade, price changes, royalties, or withdrawal. Ordinary ETH transfers are rejected; forcibly sent ETH can remain stranded and cannot be recovered.
